about.title: About Me
about.description1: I'm a Mobile Team Leader specializing in Flutter, React Native, and native Android/iOS development. I focus on building clean architecture solutions for mobile platforms with effective team collaboration.
about.description2: With experience in GoStream JSC and VietMap JSC, I've worked on various projects including social network message management, VoIP calls, map SDKs, and navigation solutions.
about.description3: I'm also an open-source maintainer contributing to native modules for Flutter and React Native, and I've worked on MapLibre Android Auto and VietMap automotive solutions.

experienceItems.title: Mobile Team & CS Team Leader
